status: prospective engineering hypothesis; no novelty or superiority established
objective: Improve one-reference image-guided category detection using synthetic-only 2D training and no borrowed pretrained weights; compare directly to the existing official OWL-ViT ViT-B/32 baseline.
candidate_contribution: Train a dense local matcher on independently rendered same-program-family instances, with counterfactual relationship edits and matched nuisance appearance, then retain partial spatial consistency during inference.

sources.title: OS2D: One-Stage One-Shot Object Detection by Matching Anchor Features
sources.overlap: Dense correlation, learned geometric alignment, aligned feature scoring and localization already exist.

sources.title: Convolutional Hough Matching Networks
sources.overlap: Trainable geometric consensus over translation and scaling already exists.

sources.title: Hypercorrelation Squeeze for Few-Shot Segmentation
sources.overlap: Multi-level support-query correlation and dense few-shot segmentation already exist.

sources.title: Few-Shot Pattern Detection via Template Matching and Regression
sources.overlap: Preserving exemplar layout and template-conditioned box regression on a frozen pretrained backbone; broad pattern benchmark RPINE. A directly relevant comparator for future work.

sources.title: Visual Atoms: Pre-training Vision Transformers with Sinusoidal Waves
sources.overlap: Mathematical contour pretraining. Natural-image headline scores use downstream natural-image training.

sources.title: SegRCDB: Semantic Segmentation via Formula-Driven Supervised Learning
sources.overlap: Multiple procedural 2D objects with exact masks and occlusion; not proof of synthetic-only semantic transfer.

sources.title: Simple Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Vision Transformers
sources.baseline_scope: Official image-guided OWL-ViT B/32 checkpoint. Not the entire OWL family and not the different paper configuration's published AP50 score.

required_evidence: Same-input and same-budget ablation of spatial consistency
Fresh natural-photo comparison with frozen thresholds and localization
Report false alarms and uncertainty alongside recall
Disclose one support crop annotation and extra real development supervision
Keep a failed or negative result if the hypothesis does not transfer
